# Three.js runtime

Three.js 0.183.0, from the official npm package `three@0.183.0`.

Included: build/three.module.min.js, build/three.core.min.js and the upstream MIT LICENSE. All modules are served locally; no CDN is used.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r183

The paper geometry, textures, layout, motion and interactions are original local implementations. No RhineLabUI model, code, fonts, audio or brand assets are included in the application.
